The MP3 files are synthetic 440 Hz test tones generated for CoopRecord, not music.
Generated with lamejs 1.2.1, sine amplitude 12000, duration 0.25 seconds:
- tone-stereo.mp3: 44100 Hz, 128 kbps, tone on the left, silence on the right.
- tone-mono.mp3: 22050 Hz, 64 kbps, mono tone.
Encoder delay/padding is included. These generated test signals are CC0.
